decisions.reason: The black-finish range extends the firm's existing drainage and metal finishing know-how, so the firm can readily assimilate market feedback and improve it, making a drop unlikely.

The shower channel for seamless coverings builds directly on proven shower drainage knowledge and is presented on its own page, indicating recognised value and successful assimilation, so drop risk is very low.

Although the pump-assisted solution fits barrier-free trends, it requires pump technology less related to the firm's core drainage know-how and its mere mention on the website suggests limited early assimilation, giving a moderate drop risk.
The tileable floor drain with grating is a core drainage product extension and is presented on its own page, indicating the firm has assimilated and supports it, so drop probability is very low.
The stainless steel design drain grate fits the firm's core metal fabrication and drainage expertise and is given a dedicated page, signalling strong relatedness and low drop risk.
